verdict.rationale: SumUp documents API keys, but only as static credentials that act on behalf of the whole merchant account that created them. Nothing in the evidence shows scopes, permission restrictions or least-privilege key issuance for an agent. A plain API key is an adjacent capability, not scoped credentials, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
